name: Loyalty Points
author: WolfyMaster LLC
description: A channel currency viewers earn by chatting. Chat commands: !points [user] (or !<currency name>), !give <user> <amount>, !gamble <amount|half|all>, !leaderboard / !top, and for moderators !addpoints / !removepoints <user> <amount>. Workflow actions give or read a viewer's balance, e.g. a bonus on follow or raid. Commands are read from chat messages rather than registered as commands, because only a chat message says whether the sender is a moderator.

settings.label: Currency name
settings.description: What your points are called in chat, like "bones" or "coins". Viewers can also check their balance with ! plus this name.

settings.label: Points per chat message
settings.description: How many points a viewer earns for chatting. Set to 0 to turn off earning from chat.

settings.label: Seconds between chat rewards
settings.description: A viewer earns chat points at most once in this many seconds, so spamming doesn't pay.

settings.label: Subscriber multiplier
settings.description: Subscribers earn this many times the normal chat reward.

settings.label: Allow !gamble
settings.description: Let viewers bet their points on a coin flip.

settings.label: Seconds between gambles
settings.description: How long a viewer waits between gambles.

actions.name: Earn points and answer points commands
actions.description: Awards chat points to the sender of a chat message and answers any points command in it. The module's own "Points from chat" workflow runs this on every chat message; there is no need to add it anywhere else.

fields.description: Points this message earned. 0 while the chatter is on cooldown.
The points command the message ran, such as "gamble". Empty when it ran none.

actions.name: Give points to a viewer
actions.description: Add points to a viewer's balance, or remove them with a negative amount (a balance never goes below 0). A viewer who has never chatted still gets them: they are waiting for them the first time they chat.

schema.label: Viewer
schema.description: The viewer's name, or their Twitch user id.

schema.label: Points
schema.description: How many points to give. A negative number takes points away.

schema.label: Reason
schema.description: Shown on the Points changed trigger, for workflows that react to it.

fields.description: The change actually applied, which is smaller than asked when a removal hit 0.

actions.name: Get a viewer's points
actions.description: Look up how many points a viewer has.

schema.label: Viewer
schema.description: The viewer's name, or their Twitch user id.

fields.description: Their balance. 0 for a viewer with no points.

triggers.name: Points changed
triggers.description: Fires whenever a viewer's balance changes: chatting, gambling, giving, or a workflow or moderator adjusting it.

fields.description: How much it changed by; negative for a loss.
What changed it: chat, gamble, give, gift from <name>, refund, carried over, added by mod, removed by mod, or a workflow's reason.
